retained_scope.method: BFS from all 23 registered extension rows through pinned DT_NEEDED; resolve own declared RPATH/RUNPATH after content-origin expansion or explicit namespace default-lib aliases. Fresh readelf --wide --dynamic on every selected ELF, comparing NEEDED/RPATH/RUNPATH/SONAME to native metadata05. No basename-only/SO-NAME-only global resolution and no ldd. This is declared-route coverage, not a complete glibc loader emulator, import-path proof, or native execution.

source_locations.fact: Absent explicit policy defaults to exact-file-fd-v1. ExtensionFileLoader uses native_load_path, spec.origin is its path, and create_module performs native initialization; failures poison/refuse through owner.fail.

Exact-file policy returns /proc/self/fd/<leafFD>; held-directory returns /proc/self/fd/<parentFD>/<leaf>, after target recheck. Directory policy requires raw device/inode target-map presence and another target recheck after load.

Directory policy trusts the native initializer and detects persistent mismatches only; directory-edge races can execute changed code before refusal and transient/anonymous/JIT mappings are outside the contract.
Qualify namespace uses explicit native mounts and read-only staged inputs, without original site exposure or a new global Pillow library search path.
